mapper.sql: select a.audit_id, a.resource_id, a.resource_title, a.audit_status, a.audit_reason, a.auditor_id, a.auditor_name, a.audit_time, a.remark, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, r.resource_type, r.category_name, r.course_name, r.uploader_name, r.publish_status from edu_resource_audit a left join edu_resource r on r.resource_id = a.resource_id
mapper.select: where a.resource_id = #{resourceId} and a.audit_status = 'pending' order by a.audit_id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into edu_resource_audit( resource_id, resource_title, audit_status, audit_reason, auditor_id, auditor_name, audit_time, remark, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{resourceId}, #{resourceTitle}, #{auditStatus}, #{auditReason}, #{auditorId}, #{auditorName}, #{auditTime}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update edu_resource_audit set audit_status = #{auditStatus}, audit_reason = #{auditReason}, auditor_id = #{auditorId}, auditor_name = #{auditorName}, audit_time = #{auditTime}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where audit_id = #{auditId}
